name: Open water west of Patong
notes: Keeps the west-coast heat layer from spilling into open Andaman water off Patong.

name: Open water west of Kamala-Surin
notes: Removes offshore heat west of Kamala and Surin while preserving the coastal tourism belt.

name: Open water west of Bang Tao
notes: Prevents false offshore heat west of Bang Tao and Laguna.

name: Open water south of Rawai
notes: Keeps south-coast demand from projecting into offshore water beyond Rawai and Promthep.

name: Open water east of Phuket Town
notes: Reduces spillover into open bay water east of Phuket Town and Ratsada.

name: Open water northwest of airport and Mai Khao
notes: Prevents airport and Mai Khao demand from creating false hot pixels out at sea.
